answer:
Decision: IMPASSE

Historical record. On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council voted on draft S/2023/641 submitted by France. It was adopted as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour. Operative paragraph 1 extended UNIFIL's existing mandate until 31 August 2024. Paragraph 15 reaffirmed its independence in carrying out mandated tasks without prior permission and its continued coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement. Brazil supported UNIFIL's continuing work. It judged that the French text kept the mandate robust and allowed UNIFIL to operate freely, while addressing some of Lebanon's concerns. China supported UNIFIL's work but said the text did not fully address Lebanon's concerns. It stressed host-State sovereignty and consent in peacekeeping and supported closer communication between UNIFIL and Lebanon's Government and military.

Fictional workshop. Brazil's inferred workshop requirement is cadence monthly. China's full workshop requirement remains ambiguous. Brazil excludes A, B, D. China excludes A, C. The signed exclusions cover every option.

The workshop changes no mandate and grants no authority.
